name: Carolina Farmstead
description: Our business was founded by Noble family patriarch Wayne as a way to get his sons working again after a devastating car accident during their college years left one in a wheelchair and the other with traumatic brain injury. Justin's physical needs as a paraplegic suddenly made it difficult for him to hold down a regular job or attend law school like he had planned, while Matt's emotional and cognitive needs placed him at a similar disadvantage in the workforce. Doctors noted how remarkable it was that one brother kept a keen intellect while the other kept a strong and fit body.  Justin and Matt vowed to work together in life and in business in order to survive-—and thrive!—as the ultimate team.
